title: IMUG-Bench: Benchmarking Unified Multimodal Models on Interleaved Understanding and Generation
title_zh: IMUG-Bench：面向交错式理解与生成的统一多模态模型基准测试
abstract_en: In recent years, unified multimodal models (UMMs) have emerged to support both understanding and generation within a single framework. Mastering dynamic, multi-turn interleaved image-text dialogues is a crucial task for UMMs in real-world applications. However, existing benchmarks fail to evaluate this important task, as they are often limited to single-turn or static settings, and typically overlook exposure bias in multi-turn interactions. To bridge this gap, we propose IMUG-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark for multi-turn interleaved image-text dialogue of UMMs that jointly evaluates their understanding and generation capabilities. Our IMUG-Bench comprises three classes: Static Spatial, Temporal Causal, and Hybrid, covering 3,113 samples and 12,034 interaction turns. It also includes dynamic understanding questions, thereby supporting evaluation that better reflects real-world multi-turn interaction scenarios. Large-scale experiments on IMUG-Bench systematically evaluate mainstream open-source and closed-source UMMs, revealing their capability boundaries and failure modes, and uncovering pronounced exposure bias on the generation side in multi-turn interactions. We further explore several test-time scaling strategies, including Chain-of-Thought, Self-Verification, and Best-of-N Sampling, which effectively improve generation accuracy and mitigate exposure bias in generation tasks. These findings provide insights into enhancing the robustness and multi-turn interaction capability of future UMMs.
abstract_zh: 近年来，统一多模态模型（Unified Multimodal Models, UMMs）开始在单一框架内同时支持多模态理解与生成。面向真实应用，模型需要掌握动态、多轮、图文交错对话能力，但现有基准多局限于单轮或静态场景，且通常忽视多轮交互中的曝光偏差（exposure bias）。为弥补这一空白，论文提出 IMUG-Bench，一个面向 UMMs 多轮交错图文对话的综合评测基准，可联合评估理解与生成能力。IMUG-Bench 包含 Static Spatial、Temporal Causal 和 Hybrid 三类任务，共 3,113 个样本、12,034 个交互轮次，并引入动态理解问题，使评测更贴近真实多轮交互场景。作者在主流开源与闭源 UMMs 上进行大规模实验，系统揭示其能力边界、失败模式，以及生成侧在多轮交互中显著的曝光偏差。进一步地，论文探索 Chain-of-Thought、Self-Verification 和 Best-of-N Sampling 等测试时扩展策略，发现它们能有效提升生成准确率并缓解生成任务中的曝光偏差。
key_points_zh: 提出 IMUG-Bench，专门评估统一多模态模型（UMMs）在多轮图文交错对话中的理解与生成能力。
基准覆盖 Static Spatial、Temporal Causal、Hybrid 三类场景，包含 3,113 个样本和 12,034 个交互轮次。
相比传统单轮或静态评测，IMUG-Bench 引入动态理解问题，更贴近真实世界多轮交互。
大规模实验发现，当前开源和闭源 UMMs 仍存在明显能力边界与失败模式，尤其在生成侧存在显著 exposure bias。
Chain-of-Thought、Self-Verification、Best-of-N Sampling 等测试时扩展策略可提升生成准确率并缓解多轮生成中的曝光偏差。

llm_assessment.comment: This is primarily a multimodal benchmark and offers little reusable infrastructure for agent runtime, governance, or self-improvement.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 这主要是一个多模态基准，对智能体运行时、治理或自我改进基础设施的贡献很有限。
